fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x31C27A0 (server heal path) creates a new event entity (FUN_14401aff0, flags |5), allocates 8 bytes of EntityHealedEventOneFrameComponent storage (ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(...,8,...)) and stores *param_2 there - the handle of the healed entity (same handle passed to the HealthChanged writer bg3.exe+0x31C2AA0). Live: 3 instances, all values shaped like entity handles (0x...7C3 | 0x01800001.. high dword).

open_questions: The component lives on a separate event entity; Entity is the healed target (no heal amount is stored here).
